test_mod_cursed_forest_entered.title: Into the Shadow Depths
test_mod_cursed_forest_entered.text: Your explorers have crossed the threshold into the Cursed Forest. The trees here do not move with the wind. They move on their own.

test_mod_shadeveil_arrived.title: Children of the Veil
test_mod_shadeveil_arrived.text: A Shadeveil has joined your colony. They keep to the shadows by habit, not by choice. A remnant of a life spent hiding from those who feared what they did not understand.

test_mod_void_first_cast.title: The Void Speaks
test_mod_void_first_cast.text: One of your colonists has mastered a spell from beyond the veil. The void does not merely destroy; it unravels. What has been unraveled cannot be put back.
